column2: 3.1 Currency and completeness

Is there a pre-defined approach to ensure that metadata is kept up-to-date?

For Explanation:
* If yes, please briefly describe your approach.
column4: Metadata are regularly updated via harvesting from the data sources
column7: When a publisher releases a new version of the dataset, it is required to update the metadata as well. This procedure is monitored centrally. On regular dataset updates this is not required as the metadata do not reflect any change (other than publication/update/initiation dates that are automatiaclly updated).

column7: Metadata are currently defined at data source setup. Chronological metadata are updated automatically.

column2: 3.3 DCAT-AP Compliance

Does the national portal follow the DCAT-AP framework or, if not, are standards in place to ensure interoperability with DCAT-AP?

For explanation:
* If the  portal follow the DCAT-AP framework, please describe how compliance with DCAT-AP is ensured
* If the portal does not follow the DCAT-AP framework, please describe how interoperability with DCAT-AP is ensured
column7:
At current status, the national portal is customly devloped/updated and the main section does not follow the DCAT-AP framework. However, compliance is due within the following months, as the portal is undergoing heavy development. The repository section of the national portal (repository.data.gov.gr) is however compliant as it is based on CKAN. If this section is not considered adequate please change answer to "no". The following answers are based on the "repository" section of the portal that hold the majority of datasets published.
RtR: still in development, so no updates on this yet!
